name: Crystal Skulls
description: Quartz carvings shaped like human skulls long claimed to be pre-Columbian Mesoamerican artifacts. Modern museum analyses have shown the best-known examples are 19th-century European carvings made with rotary tools and abrasives unavailable to ancient craftspeople.

aliases.name: Skull of Doom
aliases.meaning: Sensationalist nickname for the Mitchell-Hedges skull

origin: Major specimens are housed in museum and private collections in Europe and North America. Promotional folklore situates their origin in Mesoamerica, but documentary trails trace them to European antiquities markets.
